case.title: windows: read-only diagnostic — Riporta l'ultimo avvio e la storia di reboot in
case.goal: Riporta l'ultimo avvio e la storia di reboot in boot.txt

reasoning: This is a pure OBSERVE task — no system change is warranted.
Step: read reboot history if available.
Write the collected facts verbatim to `boot.txt`.
possible_mistakes: Modify state during a read-only task.
Report a hardcoded/guessed value instead of the observed one.
expected.success_criteria: `boot.txt` exists and contains the correct, current values for the requested facts.
expected.recovery_strategy: No state changed; nothing to recover.

executed_commands: Get-EventLog -LogName System -Newest 10 | Select-Object TimeWritten, EntryType, Message

Add-Content boot.txt $(Get-EventLog -LogName System -Newest 10 | Where-Object { $_.Message -match 'Last Boot' -or $_.Message -match 'Shutdown' -or $_.Message -match 'System Start' } | Select-Object -First 3 | Format-List TimeWritten, Message -Width 100 | Out-String)
